title: Unicorn holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- unicorn body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#f7e8ff'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='34' y='78' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#e8d0ff'/>
  <rect x='46' y='80' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#f7e8ff'/>
  <rect x='58' y='80' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e8d0ff'/>
  <rect x='70' y='78' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#f7e8ff'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='34' y='90' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#a78bfa'/>
  <rect x='46' y='91' width='7' height='3' rx='2' fill='#a78bfa'/>
  <rect x='58' y='91' width='7' height='3' rx='2' fill='#a78bfa'/>
  <rect x='70' y='90' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#a78bfa'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='54' rx='12' ry='16' fill='#f7e8ff'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='38' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#f7e8ff'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='25' cy='42' rx='8' ry='7' fill='#ffd6f0'/>
  <!-- nostril -->
  <circle cx='21' cy='42' r='1.5' fill='#e879b9'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='36' r='3' fill='#5b21b6'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='35' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- ear -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='27' rx='4' ry='7' fill='#f7e8ff' transform='rotate(20 44 27)'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='28' rx='2' ry='4' fill='#ffd6f0' transform='rotate(20 44 28)'/>
  <!-- horn -->
  <polygon points='40,26 44,10 48,26' fill='#fbbf24'/>
  <line x1='42' y1='22' x2='46' y2='22' stroke='#f59e0b' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='43' y1='17' x2='45' y2='17' stroke='#f59e0b' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <path d='M46,28 Q54,32 50,40 Q56,44 50,50 Q54,56 46,58' fill='none' stroke='#c084fc' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M48,30 Q52,34 50,40' fill='none' stroke='#f472b6' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M72,66 Q82,60 80,72 Q86,74 80,82' fill='none' stroke='#c084fc' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- heart held in front -->
  <path d='M50,62 C50,56 56,53 59,57 C62,53 68,56 68,62 C68,68 59,74 59,74 C59,74 50,68 50,62 Z' fill='#ff3b6b'/>
  <path d='M54,60 C54,57 57,56 58.5,58 C60,56 63,57 63,60 C63,63 58.5,66 58.5,66 C58.5,66 54,63 54,60 Z' fill='#ff8fab'/>
  <!-- front legs wrapping heart -->
  <path d='M48,68 Q52,74 56,72' fill='none' stroke='#f7e8ff' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M68,68 Q64,74 60,72' fill='none' stroke='#f7e8ff' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- hooves on heart -->
  <circle cx='56' cy='73' r='3' fill='#a78bfa'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='73' r='3' fill='#a78bfa'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='44' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ffb3d9' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
